evidence.decision: Chooses determinate status only from whole-operation measurement and separates cancellation, pause and expensive partial-work loss.
evidence.artifact: Requires measurement basis, state transitions and recovery contract with actual progress/status changes.
evidence.transformation: Backup example replaces scan-only 90 percent progress and silent Cancel loss with whole-work measurement or honest uncertainty and deliberate pause/cancel.
evidence.verification: Checks unknown-to-known work, stage bounds, stalls, completion/failure and cancel/resume; fake percentages or resolved spinning fails.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies Mac indeterminate/background treatment and mobile pull-to-refresh while preserving source-specific reference details; actual timing/backend completion needs execution.
evidence.handoffs: Loading handles content strategy and Buttons handles initiating feedback, conditional on the operation.
evidence.distinctiveness: Denominator honesty, stable indicator geometry and consequential cancellation distinguish progress from generic loading decoration.
